data.description:
## Problem
Nothing validates, before a reconcile pass mutates a live client Jira, that the mapped
projects actually EXIST / are visible to the bridge bot. Two live-only failure modes:
1. A mapped-but-nonexistent (or decommissioned / permission-lost) project key is
   syntactically valid, so _validate_project_key passes; the failure only surfaces
   deep in fan-out as an ACLI error. This is exactly the 05b8 incident class.
2. resolve_project (projects_store.py) returns mapping.legacy_default VERBATIM,
   unvalidated. Every unbound/legacy ticket (absent bridge_project) resolves there. The
   cross-project write guard's allowed set = read_projects().keys() and EXCLUDES creates
   (applier.py _cross_project_targets), so a legacy_default pointing at a real-but-wrong
   (or nonexistent) project drives a mass CREATE storm into the wrong place, unguarded.

## Approach
Add a reconcile-pass PREFLIGHT that runs BEFORE any outbound mutation and validates that
every project in read_projects(repo_root).keys() PLUS legacy_default (when set) is
visible to the configured backend (a project-search / getVisibleProjects probe via the
ACLI transport / backend port — reuse access_check.py's client + retry helpers). On a
missing/invisible project, FAIL FAST with a clear, actionable message naming the
offending key(s) and the fix (correct projects.json / legacy_default), rather than
letting fan-out crash mid-pass. Fail-closed on a hard auth error; distinguish
"project not visible" from "transport unavailable".

## Acceptance criteria
1. A pass with a mapped key not visible to the bot aborts at preflight with a clear
   message naming the key BEFORE any Jira write.
2. legacy_default (when non-empty) is included in the preflight existence check.
3. An all-valid mapping passes preflight and proceeds unchanged (no behavior change on
   the happy path).
4. Preflight is observable (alert/log) and does not add a live Jira call to unit tests
   (transport is injected/faked).

## Test plan
- Unit with a fake transport whose project-visibility probe reports {GOOD} visible,
  BAD absent: assert preflight raises/aborts naming BAD, and that a mapping of only
  visible keys passes. RED first (no preflight -> pass proceeds to fan-out).
- Unit: legacy_default=WRONG (not visible) is caught by preflight.

## Sequencing
Lives in access_check.py (new mapped-projects preflight helper) + wiring at the pass
entrypoint (__main__.py / reconcile pass start). Disjoint from A/B/C/E files. Reads
projects_store (no edit).
data.title: Reconciler preflight: verify every mapped project + legacy_default is visible in target Jira before any mutation
